## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px 48px 24px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;">Model Evaluation: What We Measured</h1>
  </div>

  <p style="font-size:21px;line-height:1.28;color:#344054;margin:0 0 16px 0;max-width:1120px;">
    We used several metrics because the target is imbalanced and the smaller satisfaction groups are harder to predict.
  </p>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 0.95fr;gap:24px;margin-top:2px;">
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 10px 0 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:12px;">Evaluation design</div>
      <div style="display:grid;gap:11px;font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.28;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Held-out test set:</strong> final performance was checked after fitting and tuning.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Same data split:</strong> all models used the same train-test split for fair comparison.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">3-class focus:</strong> easier to interpret than the 5-class target and more stable for prediction.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Class-level check:</strong> we inspected whether each class was actually recognised.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 10px 0 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:12px;">Why accuracy is not enough</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.3;color:#344054;">
        Since most developers are in the satisfied group, a model can get reasonable accuracy by mainly predicting the largest class. This is why Macro F1 and Kappa are needed to judge whether the model is truly useful.
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:16px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;">
        <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.25;color:#1f2a44;font-weight:720;">Main metric: Macro F1</div>
        <div style="font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.25;color:#475467;margin-top:4px;">It treats Dissatisfied, Neutral, and Satisfied equally.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:24px;">
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 12px 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Accuracy</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.27;color:#344054;">Overall correct prediction rate.</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.23;color:#667085;margin-top:8px;">Good for a quick view.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 12px 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Macro F1</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.27;color:#344054;">Average F1 across classes.</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.23;color:#667085;margin-top:8px;">Best for class imbalance.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 12px 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Kappa</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.27;color:#344054;">Agreement beyond chance.</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.23;color:#667085;margin-top:8px;">Checks real model value.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 12px 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Class recall</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.27;color:#344054;">Shows which classes are missed.</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.23;color:#667085;margin-top:8px;">Useful for diagnosis.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:auto;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 18px;">
    <div style="font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#1f2a44;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">
      Key point: the evaluation focuses on balanced prediction, not only the largest satisfaction group.
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px 48px 24px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;">Model Evaluation: Overall Test Results</h1>
  </div>

  <p style="font-size:21px;line-height:1.28;color:#344054;margin:0 0 14px 0;max-width:1120px;">
    The 3-class target produced more stable results. Random Forest and Gradient Boosting were the strongest balanced models.
  </p>

  <div style="display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;margin-top:2px;">
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 120px 120px 120px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:16.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Model</div>
      <div style="font-size:16.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">Accuracy</div>
      <div style="font-size:16.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">Kappa</div>
      <div style="font-size:16.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">Macro F1</div>
      <div style="font-size:16.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Short interpretation</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 120px 120px 120px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Random Forest</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.665</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.237</div>
      <div style="font-size:19.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.472</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">Best Macro F1, strongest balanced result.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 120px 120px 120px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Gradient Boosting</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.688</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.241</div>
      <div style="font-size:19.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.471</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">Very close to RF, with higher accuracy.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 120px 120px 120px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Logistic Regression</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.639</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.232</div>
      <div style="font-size:19.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.462</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">Simple and competitive baseline.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 120px 120px 120px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Naive Bayes</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.709</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.178</div>
      <div style="font-size:19.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.435</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">Highest accuracy, but weaker class balance.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 120px 120px 120px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Neural Network</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.677</div>
      <div style="font-size:18.5px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.234</div>
      <div style="font-size:19.5px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.404</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.8px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">Good overall result, weaker Macro F1.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:18px;">
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Best Macro F1</div>
      <div style="font-size:17px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;">Random Forest had the highest Macro F1 at 0.472.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Best accuracy</div>
      <div style="font-size:17px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;">Naive Bayes had the highest accuracy, but lower Kappa and Macro F1.</div>
    </div>
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Main lesson</div>
      <div style="font-size:17px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;">Accuracy alone can hide weak prediction for smaller classes.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px 48px 24px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;">Model Evaluation: Class-Level Diagnosis</h1>
  </div>

  <p style="font-size:21px;line-height:1.28;color:#344054;margin:0 0 16px 0;max-width:1120px;">
    Class-level results show the main difficulty. The model predicts the largest class much better than the two smaller classes.
  </p>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch;margin-top:4px;">
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 14px 14px 14px;background:#ffffff;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:228px;">
      <div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Dissatisfied</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;min-height:44px;">Smallest group, hardest to recognise.</div>
      <div style="font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;margin:14px 0 4px 0;">0.275</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;color:#475467;margin-bottom:12px;">F1-score</div>
      <div style="background:#eef2f7;border-radius:999px;height:12px;overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="width:29%;height:12px;background:#315f9f;border-radius:999px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:15.5px;color:#475467;margin-top:7px;">Recall: 29.0%</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 14px 14px 14px;background:#ffffff;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:228px;">
      <div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Neutral</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;min-height:44px;">Middle group overlaps with both sides.</div>
      <div style="font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;margin:14px 0 4px 0;">0.315</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;color:#475467;margin-bottom:12px;">F1-score</div>
      <div style="background:#eef2f7;border-radius:999px;height:12px;overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="width:27.5%;height:12px;background:#315f9f;border-radius:999px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:15.5px;color:#475467;margin-top:7px;">Recall: 27.5%</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 14px 14px 14px;background:#ffffff;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:228px;">
      <div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Satisfied</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;min-height:44px;">Largest group, easiest to predict.</div>
      <div style="font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;margin:14px 0 4px 0;">0.822</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;color:#475467;margin-bottom:12px;">F1-score</div>
      <div style="background:#eef2f7;border-radius:999px;height:12px;overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="width:85.1%;height:12px;background:#315f9f;border-radius:999px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:15.5px;color:#475467;margin-top:7px;">Recall: 85.1%</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:22px;">
    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Pattern 1</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.3px;line-height:1.25;color:#344054;">Satisfied has much higher F1 and recall because it is the majority class.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Pattern 2</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.3px;line-height:1.25;color:#344054;">Neutral is difficult because it sits between negative and positive satisfaction.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Pattern 3</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.3px;line-height:1.25;color:#344054;">Dissatisfied needs more signal because it has fewer cases and weaker separation.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:auto;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 18px;">
    <div style="font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#1f2a44;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">
      Key point: the model is useful for broad satisfaction prediction, but minority classes remain the main evaluation challenge.
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
